text:
pagerbot: ALERT 03:21 UTC — unusual keystore access from indexer-4 (5 failed attempts then one success). severity: P1. paging oncall@infra.
jen (sre): saw this, pulling logs now. which region?
pagerbot: source: indexer-4.us-west-2, src_ip=18.214.10.7, user=svc-ingest. recent deploy: none in last 2h.
aaron (oncall): I'm on it. dropping connections to indexer-4, cordon node.
jen (sre): copy. stopping indexer-4 pod: `kubectl -n obs delete pod indexer-4 --grace-period=0`
raj (sec): hold on on the delete, we want forensic snapshot first. can we grab /var/log/indexer/*.log and `/etc/keystore/access.log` and gcore?
jen (sre): grabbing logs now, tarring to /tmp/forensics.tar.gz then `scp` to secure host.
infra-bot: upload started -> s3://redwood-sec-uploads/incident-3123456781/forensics.tar.gz (restricted ACL).
raj (sec): initial look: there is a wire-probe from 18.214.10.7 to our keystore service, unusual `GET /v1/keys` with svc-ingest token. token origin looks like ephemeral CI token (staging?)
katie (pm): any customer impact? do we need to alert legal or impacted customers?
aaron (oncall): quick check: no spike in customer-facing 5xxs. some metrics show increased auth failures to indexer API but no data-plane reads observed yet.
raj (sec): assume compromise until proven otherwise. immediate actions: 1) revoke svc-ingest credentials 2) rotate keystore master key 3) block src_ip 4) preserve forensics.
jen (sre): revoking creds now: `auth-admin revoke svc-ingest` -> done.
infra-bot: svc-ingest token revoked by aaron at 03:29 UTC.
aaron (oncall): firewall rule added to block 18.214.10.7 at edge LB.
jen (sre): rotating keystore master with canary: kicking off rotation job `keystore-rotate --canary indexer` (logs in /var/log/keystore-rotate.log).
raj (sec): good. prepare a scoped key rotation plan for customer-facing keys if any exposure is confirmed. start internal severity call in 10m.
katie (pm): please prepare a short note for CS if we need to notify customers (timeline, affected services, mitigations).
jen (sre): snapshot uploaded, rotation job completed canary, rolling across cluster in progress (no errors so far).
raj (sec): forensics summary: evidence of credential replay from an ephemeral token minted by CI runner `ci-runner-742`. tagging CI team to audit.
aaron (oncall): handing off to sec team and ci-platform for deeper review. I'm staying on bridge for 30m.
raj (sec): agree. actions assigned: raj -> full keystore audit, jen -> confirm rotation sweep completed, ci-team -> audit runner issuance logs, infra -> retain blocked IP and network captures for 90d.
jen (sre): rotation sweep done at 03:46 UTC, no unauthorized reads detected in audit logs post-rotation.
infra-bot: network pcap archived to s3://redwood-sec-uploads/incident-3123456781/pcap.pcap.gz
katie (pm): flagging for legal review, prepping customer comms draft.
raj (sec): closing initial triage: containment successful, credentials revoked and rotated, forensics preserved. escalation to incident review for root cause + CI token hardening. next update in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
aaron (oncall): thanks all — I'll hand the active bridge to raj and step off in 10m.
jen (sre): leaving node cordoned for 24h, will uncordon after cleanup.
pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P3 at 04:02 UTC.
raj (sec): ticket created INC-2026-3123456781, linking artifacts. closing thread for live mitigation, postmortem assigned.
